LESSON: ISLAMIC

Grade: PP2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: MORAL
Topic 4.1.3: Islamic

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Islamic. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate appropriate 4.1.1 Toileting to Islamic teachings (Suggested time – 2 lesson) life of water during and after toileting 199
2. practice proper use of water Learners sequence pictures on during and after toileting (Istinja)
3. appreciate the Islamic teaching of body cleanliness and hygiene leaving toilet with right foot and hand washing).

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. demonstrate appropriate 4.1.1 Toileting to Islamic teachings (Suggested time – 2 lesson) life of water during and after toileting 199
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate appropriate 4.1.1 Toileting to Islamic teachings (Suggested time – 2 lesson) life of water during and after toileting 199. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. practice proper use of water Learners sequence pictures on during and after toileting (Istinja)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to practice proper use of water Learners sequence pictures on during and after toileting (Istinja). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the Islamic teaching of body cleanliness and hygiene leaving toilet with right foot and hand washing).
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the Islamic teaching of body cleanliness and hygiene leaving toilet with right foot and hand washing). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Islamic.
2. Explain Islamic to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Islamic.
4. Show that you can: demonstrate appropriate 4.1.1 Toileting to Islamic teachings (Suggested time – 2 lesson) life of water during and after toileting 199
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Islamic. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Islamic important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. demonstrate appropriate 4.1.1 Toileting to Islamic teachings (Suggested time – 2 lesson) life of water during and after toileting 199
2. practice proper use of water Learners sequence pictures on during and after toileting (Istinja)
3. appreciate the Islamic teaching of body cleanliness and hygiene leaving toilet with right foot and hand washing).

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
